title_en: Super Opportunity!! Near the Botanical Garden, Ideal Store for Investment!!
description_en: Super Opportunity!! Ideal Store for Investment at the Botanical Garden!! The shop is located on the edge of the main road, making it a very good opportunity for investment as it has a glass facade from the street and is suitable for various business activities such as coffee bar, bakery, bakery, pharmacy, etc. The store also has a veranda in the front part which can be used and space for two parking spaces in the side part. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
